name: Thaumaturgy (Mastery of the Mortal Shell) — 1 Basic — Vertigo

system.description: With but a light touch, the thaumaturge overcomes her target with dizziness and disorientation, rendering the victim one Trait down on all Physical Challenges for the remainder of the scene. A ready or suspicious target may require a successful Physical Challenge to affect. Effects last for a number of turns equal to the Mental Traits spent by the caster.
system.duration: Number of turns equal to Mental Traits spent
